## 1. Executive Summary & International Remote Positioning

Yuri Vieira Teixeira is a Full-Stack Software Engineer and Back-End Programming Instructor specializing in Java (Spring Boot), TypeScript (React, Angular), and Python (Django). He currently teaches Back-End Software Engineering at SENAI / FAETEC, mentoring engineering students in Java OOP, relational database modeling (PostgreSQL / DBeaver), and RESTful API architecture.

### International Remote Work Suitability
- **Geographic Location**: Nova Friburgo, State of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
- **Time Zone**: UTC-3 (BRT - Brasília Time).
  - **North America (EST/EDT - Toronto, Montreal, New York, Boston, Miami)**: 1 to 2 hours time difference. Perfect full-day real-time collaboration (9 AM - 5 PM EST corresponds directly to 10 AM - 6 PM UTC-3).
  - **Europe (GMT / WET / CET - London, Dublin, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris)**: 3 to 5 hours time difference. Substantial daily overlap during afternoon European hours, leaving European mornings ideal for uninterrupted deep work.
  - **Latin America & Brazil**: Exact local or +/- 1-hour time zone alignment.
- **Engagement & Billing Modality**:
  - Open to **B2B Independent Contractor**, **Employer of Record (EOR)**, and full-time arrangements.
  - Ready for streamlined invoicing through international platforms including **Deel, Remote.com, OysterHR, Wise**, or direct international SWIFT wire transfers.
- **Language Proficiency**:
  - **English**: Advanced (B2+/C1 CEFR). Fully capable of authoring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), conducting technical RFC discussions, leading code reviews, and collaborating in synchronous video meetings and asynchronous Slack/Linear/GitHub workflows.
  - **Spanish**: Advanced (B2+ CEFR). Professional working fluency.
  - **Portuguese**: Native speaker.

## 3. Flagship Projects & Architectural Deep Dive

### 3.1. ZEISS Recommendation Assistant
- **Nature**: Corporate MVP developed for ZEISS Group (Collaborative: 11 developers, 1 Product Owner, 1 Scrum Master).
- **Domain**: Automated Ophthalmic Prescription Processing & Lens Recommendation Intelligence.
- **Problem**: Optical shop associates across partner retail chains manually interpreted complex ophthalmic prescriptions, leading to subjective, error-prone recommendations, lengthy customer wait times, and zero aggregate conversion metrics.
- **Solution**: A full-stack web platform integrating an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipeline connected to an AI agent (n8n / RAG) that extracts clinical metrics, cross-references patient lifestyle habits, and automatically recommends the optimal ZEISS lens tier.
- **Key Architectural Decisions**:
  - Developed modular, accessible UI components in React and TypeScript consuming authenticated backend APIs.
  - Implemented 3-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) via stateless JWT authentication: ZEISS Corporate Admin, Store Manager, and Sales Associate.
  - Built real-time analytics dashboards tracking seller conversion rates, store rankings, and top-recommended lens models.
  - Introduced pre-recommendation clinical validation interfaces ensuring optical associates verify OCR extractions before recommendation generation.
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Java 17, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, JWT, OCR, n8n, RAG, REST APIs.

### 3.2. Automated Payroll System (Java 17 / JDBC / MVC+DAO)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/payroll-system-java
- **Domain**: Financial Calculation Engine under Brazilian Labor & Tax Legislation.
- **Problem**: Batch-processing employee salary and deduction records with progressive statutory tax brackets (INSS and IRRF) without rounding errors, while enforcing raw relational SQL persistence without relying on ORMs.
- **Solution**: A pure Java 17 enterprise system implementing a layered MVC + DAO architecture utilizing raw JDBC to interact directly with PostgreSQL.
- **Key Architectural Decisions**:
  - Eliminated IEEE 754 floating-point inaccuracies by enforcing `BigDecimal` with `RoundingMode.HALF_UP` across all tax calculation services.
  - Designed custom domain exceptions (`CpfInvalidoException`, `DependenteSemTitularException`, `SalarioInvalidoException`) to prevent corrupted records from propagating into database transactions.
  - Implemented the Singleton design pattern for database connection factory management (`ConexaoBancoDados`).
  - Created defensive streaming CSV parsers and writers for batch report generation.
- **Technologies**: Java 17, PostgreSQL, JDBC, MVC Architecture, DAO Pattern, BigDecimal, Singleton Pattern, CSV I/O.

### 3.3. Aurora — Personal Growth Platform
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/aurora-growth-platform
- **Domain**: Cross-Platform Mobile Application for Goal Tracking, Mentorships & Community.
- **Problem**: Unifying multi-tiered navigation patterns, responsive gamification mechanics (XP and badges), complex form validation, and native device hardware access in a single mobile experience.
- **Solution**: A mobile application built with React Native and Expo SDK 54, combining Drawer, Stack, and Tab navigation with client-side state persistence and native hardware integrations.
- **Key Architectural Decisions**:
  - Configured hybrid navigation using React Navigation combining custom Drawer menus, Stack flows, and bottom Tabs.
  - Integrated React Hook Form with Zod schemas for strict client-side validation.
  - Integrated native device peripherals via Expo Location (GPS coordinates), Expo ImagePicker (Camera/Gallery uploads), and Expo SecureStore for encrypted token storage alongside AsyncStorage.
  - Built dynamic QR-code event check-in systems for mentorship validation.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Expo SDK 54, TypeScript, React Navigation, Zod, React Hook Form, Axios, AsyncStorage, Expo SecureStore.

### 3.4. Django Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/django-fullstack-ecommerce
- **Domain**: High-Concurrency E-Commerce Backend & Vanilla JS Frontend.
- **Problem**: Preventing race conditions in order processing, avoiding duplicate charges from asynchronous payment webhooks firing multiple times, eliminating N+1 query bottlenecks in ORM queries, and building a lightweight frontend without heavy SPA frameworks.
- **Solution**: An enterprise Django architecture organized around the Service Layer pattern, wrapping critical business logic in atomic database transactions (`transaction.atomic`) and enforcing idempotent webhook handlers.
- **Key Architectural Decisions**:
  - Built an idempotent webhook handler ensuring that multiple calls for the same order transition safely from pending to paid without duplicate ledger entries.
  - Eliminated N+1 queries using Django ORM's `select_related` and `prefetch_related` across products, orders, and coupons.
  - Built a modular Vanilla JavaScript frontend utilizing native HTML5 `<template>` and `textContent` DOM manipulation to provide zero-framework reactivity with native CSRF and XSS immunity.
- **Technologies**: Python 3.12, Django, SQLite / PostgreSQL, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), REST API, Webhooks, Service Layer, Atomic Transactions.

### 3.5. High-Performance Personal Portfolio
- **URL**: https://devyurivieira.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/portfolio
- **Domain**: Modern Frontend Engineering, WebGL Shaders & Test Automation.
- **Solution**: Developed with Angular 22 standalone components, native Angular Signals (`signal`, `computed`), and `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` throughout.
- **Key Architectural Decisions**:
  - Implemented an interactive, GPU-accelerated WebGL / Three.js particle canvas with pointer reactivity.
  - Integrated dynamic trilingual internationalization (PT-BR, EN, ES) with language persistence.
  - Established a 3-layer automated testing suite: 66 Vitest unit tests, 38 Playwright E2E specs including Axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audits, and 17 Cypress E2E specs (total: 121 automated tests).
  - Achieved a perfect 100/100/100/100 Google Lighthouse audit across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.
- **Technologies**: Angular 22, TypeScript 6.0, Three.js, WebGL, SCSS, Vitest, Playwright, Axe-core, Cypress, PWA.

### 3.6. Anime Weather Platform
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DevYuriVieira/anime-weather-platform
- **Domain**: AI Prompt Engineering & Multi-API Contextual Recommendation.
- **Solution**: Real-time atmospheric data from OpenWeather API feeds a custom Weather-Mood-Genre engine that queries the Jikan API, while Google Gemini AI generates contextual descriptions and witty dialogues in a glassmorphism React UI.
- **Technologies**: React, Vite, TypeScript, OpenWeather API, Jikan API, Google Gemini SDK, CSS Modules.

### Q2: How does Yuri's timezone align with teams in North America and Europe?
**A**: Yuri is located in Nova Friburgo, Rio de Janeiro (UTC-3). For North American teams (EST/EDT - Toronto, New York, Montreal), there is an almost complete 7-to-8 hour overlap with only a 1-to-2 hour difference. For European teams (London, Berlin, Amsterdam), there is a 3-to-5 hour daily afternoon overlap, allowing real-time syncs while preserving European mornings for focused async progress.
